# Decisions

One line per product decision: the date, who decided, and what. Newest first. Older ones are in
[the direction page](../DIRECTION.md).

- 2026-11-16 · owner · The engine is written in Zig. It is the core piece: performant, secure, easy to reason about, and every other tool only talks to it.
- 2026-11-16 · owner · The Mac app is written in Swift and holds no logic.
- 2026-11-16 · owner · The feature list ([features.jsonl](features.jsonl)) is sorted so the most certain entries come first.
- 2026-11-15 · owner · Product truth is in `docs/product/`; outside pages such as [GitHub](https://github.com) are only links.
- 2026-11-15 · owner · A decision that spans
  two lines is one item.
- 2026-11-15 · owner · No time estimates.
